items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: his neighbor across the hall, that's a Dersh, and she would dance with him

ctx.x: I think he's measurable out there. Good Lord, he must be. Considering that Triangle Jazz Blues was copyrighted in 1915, as I remember, he must be pretty ancient.

Yeah, oh yeah, he's quite old, and, uh, I think he has a pacemaker, and, uh, has cut back on his dancing now, but he likes purple robes of Cairo, and his neighbor across the hall, that's a Dersh, and she would dance with him. She happens to be a friend of ours. She would
dance with him. I think, uh, he still gets around. He would, at least until recently,
